fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' throws a globule of Black Mist in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and attaches to them for 1 second.
fields.description2: After the duration or when the target dies, the Black Mist spreads out of the target, {{tip|root|rooting}} them and surrounding enemies for a few seconds.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
